issues.legal_issue: A consumer complaint remains within the limitation period where subsequent reminders and acceptance of part payment extend the cause of action.
Pecuniary jurisdiction is determined by the aggregate relief claimed, including compensation, and not solely by the amount deposited.
An offer of possession made without the required completion and firefighting clearance certificates is legally invalid.
A purchaser’s contribution to delay may justify denying interest from the date of the original payment while still awarding a refund with interest from the complaint date.
Failure to provide required certificates and a purchaser’s delay in paying additional charges may warrant additional compensation reflecting both parties’ lapses.
